column1: # English word -> how an Uzbek reader should spell it so the Uzbek voice says it the English way.
# Used by uznorm/english.py inside English stretches of mixed text (IELTS examiner speech). Lower case.
# Rules of thumb: "w" -> v, "th" -> t/d, schwa -> e/a, long a -> ey, long i -> ay, long o -> ou, "the" -> di.
# Words that are also Uzbek words are marked * : they count as English only next to other English words.
